review_scope: Independent read-only review of saved probe, native host result, images and exact target/stock public simulator sources. No GUI process was launched and no production/test/CI source was edited.

observed_controls_verified.interpretation: Real native View2D coordinates changed. Probe does not directly write those coordinates between before/after; effect is not a model counter.

observed_controls_verified.case: Correctly selected native title; 1px cursor without PAN
observed_controls_verified.interpretation: Native node selection succeeds; no viewport displacement or native transform modal is observed at the subthreshold sample.

observed_controls_verified.case: Correctly selected title; PAN1px then same-position cursor
observed_controls_verified.interpretation: Returned actual Event prev_xy gives nonzero PAN delta1; native graph origin moves before modal acquisition while node RNA location stays unchanged.

observed_controls_verified.case: 12px cursor native macro acquisition, PAN3px, release
observed_controls_verified.interpretation: Native NODE_OT_translate_attach ownership is observed and persists through PAN, then disappears on release. This is not proof of a completed geometric move because node.location remains unchanged.

api_source_review.actual_event_observations: send() calls public Window.event_simulate and immediately records returned native Event.mouse_x/y, mouse_prev_x/y, is_tablet and is_mouse_absolute. It does not fabricate an event counter or overwrite Event fields.
api_source_review.native_modals: Driver reads Window.modal_operators directly. Target rna_wm.cc:1073-1089 iterates actual WM operator handlers; declaration2821-2833 is a read-only collection. The screenshots show native translate footer state after acquisition.
api_source_review.simulator_input_limits: Target rna_wm_api.cc:700-782 and stock714-796 copy eventstate, accept current x/y and modifiers, clear tablet data and call WM_event_add_simulate; no public prev_xy/delta argument exists. API definition stock883-901 shows event is the returned output, not an additional input.
api_source_review.mousemove_prev_semantics: Target wm_event_system.cc:197-224 and stock196-223 copy simulated MOUSEMOVE current coordinates into both eventstate.prev_xy and event.prev_xy. Therefore a directly following same-position simulated PAN has zero delta. Nonzero logged PAN is seeded using preceding motion at a distinct point.
api_source_review.readonly_previous_coords: Target rna_wm.cc:2544-2553 clears PROP_EDITABLE for Event.mouse_prev_x/y. No forbidden field write or native ABI injection appears in probe.
api_source_review.reorder_limit: The stated NO_FAITHFUL_SAME_PAYLOAD_ORDER_REPLAY is supported for reversing this same two-event pair through the examined public API: preserving a nonzero PAN delta would require changing coordinates or adding another seeding event. It is not a claim that every imaginable scripted native event sequence is impossible.
api_source_review.simulator_route_limit: Public simulation queues native WM events but bypasses actual GHOST ingestion/coalescing and clears tablet provenance. This is host WM evidence, not a physical Pencil replay.

visual_review.finding: Native Shader Editor, two actual nodes, selected value node and native transform status/footer are visible. Images support valid native title targeting and modal acquisition; numeric one-pixel viewport change is established by native View2D reads, not image measurement.

preserved_failures_review: Background crash evidence explicitly labels missing eventstate cause as inference. First DPI-invalid title attempt is retained and excluded; its successful unhandled PAN control does not stand in for title controls. Accepted evidence comes from attempt2.
nonblocking_precision_notes: Logged drag_threshold_mouse3/tablet10 are preference values. Effective drag threshold is scaled by UI_SCALE_FAC in target WM_event_drag_threshold; 1px is still below both. Avoid labeling3 as a universal effective pixel threshold.

title_press_node_xy in driver is descriptive arithmetic rather than an inverse transform of actual window coordinates. Actual selection, computed DPI-correct window point and screenshots support title hit; do not reuse that metadata as a precise measured node-space coordinate.

Native Window.modal_operators observes root macro NODE_OT_translate_attach, not its active child identity. The macro/transform source trace supplies child semantics; raw host result alone should not claim a child callback trace.
Source input line range target700-801 extends past simulator body782. The relevant behavior is supported within700-782; extra ending lines do not add evidence.
unsupported_inferences_rejected: No target5.0 iOS compiled behavior, UIKit/Pencil device scheduling, native socket link, completed node move/Undo parity, Circle/proportional parity or event reorder parity follows from these host controls.
Unchanged node.location after acquisition and cleanup must not be described as a completed moved-node workflow.
Process exit file records both owned PIDs inactive at its timestamp; this review does not inspect unrelated user app processes.
production_action: None proposed. Existing current production/native-build gate remains owned by root; this review adds bounded evidence only.
